svg.title: Guildmaster Dungeons — Shared Editable Skill Tree Layout
svg.desc: This layout controls every class. Drag nodes in a browser, press Save SVG, then replace skill-tree-layout.svg in the project.

g.title: Titanic Bulwark — +10% Armor and +10% maximum HP.
Perfect Motion — +5% Critical Chance and +5% Physical Dodge.
Arcane Citadel — +10% Magic Armor and +10% maximum Mana.
Blood Fury — +6% damage while below 35% HP.
Vital Leech — Lifesteal is 50% more effective, but this character cannot regain HP in any other way.
Blood Magic — Mana is disabled. Abilities spend HP instead, and cannot reduce you below 1 HP.
Lingering Agony — +20% damage with damage-over-time effects.
Deterioration — Deal 30% less direct damage, but damage-over-time effects deal 60% more damage.
Mana Bastion — +5% maximum Mana and +0.2 Mana regeneration.
Mana Shield — Damage that reaches HP depletes Mana first. Mana regeneration is halved.
Unraveling Ward — +5% Magic Armor and +3% maximum Mana.
Aether Conversion — Convert all Magic Armor into maximum Mana, but abilities cost twice as much.
Resolute Force — Critical hits are disabled, but all damage is increased by 30%.
Immovable — Gain 35% Armor and Magic Armor, but Physical and Magical Dodge become 0%.
Deep Recovery — Regenerate 0.5% maximum HP each round.
Second Wind — Regenerate 1% maximum HP each round.
Undying Growth — +1 HP and 2% maximum HP regeneration per round.
Spines — Reflect 3% of damage absorbed by Armor.
Adamant Bastion — +12% Armor and reflect 6% of damage absorbed by Armor.
Sanguine Force — +4% damage while below 50% HP.
Blood Rush — +3% damage after taking damage.
Crimson Engine — +5% Lifesteal and +10% damage while below 50% HP.
Perfect Strike — +8% Critical Chance and +20% Critical Damage.
Untouchable Tempo — +8% Initiative and +4% Physical Dodge.
Lingering Pain — Damage-over-time effects last 1 additional round.
Plaguecraft — +8% Status Chance and +20% damage-over-time damage.
Endless Font — +12% maximum Mana and +0.5 Mana regeneration.
Reversal — Restore 4 Mana when Magic Armor breaks.
Aether Fortress — +12% Magic Armor and +4% Magical Dodge.
Overflow — Overhealing restores 10% as Magic Armor.
Miracle Worker — +15% Healing Done and 15% stronger overhealing conversion.
Master of Blades — Swords deal 20% more damage and bleeds deal 25% more damage.
Sunder — Axes deal 15% more damage to Armor.
Wide Swing — Axes deal 5% more damage per living enemy.
Execution — Axes deal 12% more damage to targets below 30% HP.
Headsman — Axes deal 22% more damage and 25% more to targets below 30% HP.
Crushing — Hammers deal 18% more damage to Armor.
Shatter — Hammers deal 25% more damage to Armor.
Stability — +2 Block while wielding a Hammer.
Worldbreaker — Hammers deal 24% more damage and 40% more damage to Armor.
Death by a Thousand Cuts — Daggers deal 20% more damage; +10% Status Chance and +20% Critical Damage.
First Shot — Bows deal 12% more damage to full-health targets.
Linebreaker — Bows deal 5% more damage per living enemy.
Deadeye — Bows deal 22% more damage and gain +8% Critical Chance.
Phalanx — +3% Physical Dodge while wielding a Spear.
Unbroken Line — Spears deal 22% more damage and gain +10% Pierce.
Runic Force — Arcane weapons deal 8% more damage.
Channeling — +5% maximum Mana while wielding an Arcane weapon.
Archmage Focus — Arcane weapons deal 24% more damage and gain +10% Status Chance.
Overcritical — Critical Chance can reach 200%. Chance above 100% produces a devastating double-multiplier critical hit, but maximum HP is reduced by 12%.
Pandemic — Statuses you inflict spread to every living enemy, but your direct damage is reduced by 15%.
Edge of Death — Deal 50% more damage below 50% HP, but 50% less damage above 50% HP.
Opening Salvo — The first ability cast each battle deals double damage, but abilities cost 15% more Mana.
Relentless Control — Enemy Stun Resistance is halved against this character, but this character deals 10% less damage.
Calculated Violence — Every 10 INT grants +1% Critical Chance, but maximum Mana is reduced by 15%.
Pure Renewal — Double HP regeneration, but Lifesteal cannot restore HP.
Tempo Gambit — Deal 30% more damage to slower targets, but take 30% more damage from faster enemies.
Reprisal — Deal 30% more damage after taking damage since your previous turn.
Compressed Agony — Damage-over-time effects deal 50% more damage but last half as many rounds.
Crowd Hunter — Deal 10% more damage for each living enemy, but deal 20% less damage against a lone enemy.
Killing Spree — Gain 10% damage for every enemy this character personally kills this battle; lose the stacks after battle.
Attribute Echo — Add 30% of your main attribute as a flat bonus to each other attribute, but reduce your main attribute by 10%.
g.text: attribute as a flat bonus to

g.title: Spellblade Covenant — Weapon attacks deal 40% more damage, but damaging abilities deal 25% less damage.
Glass Cannon — Deal 45% more damage while Armor and Magic Armor are empty, but both maximum protections are reduced by 25%.
